audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2, 3 and first item were marked Heimerdinger wins while the whys text on those same rows said Akshan chips him from outside turret range and reclaims tempo at first item.
audit.why: Avengerang is 850 range and Heroic Swing 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s off terrain; turret range is 350, so Akshan genuinely owns the pre-nest levels. Going Rogue camouflage gives him first-item map tempo. The page rendered two answers to those rows.
audit.corrected: Levels 2, 3 and first item now read Akshan on both layers, matching the packet chart and the existing whys text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-2 phase text claimed 'Three turrets' and the first-item row named only Liandry's.
audit.why: Two H-28G charges exist at level 2. Akshan's first-item spike is camouflage roaming, not a duel, which is what actually flips that stage.
audit.corrected: Phase text now names Avengerang's 850 range, Heroic Swing's 18s and Going Rogue camouflage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade was called 'CH-3X' in seven places, turret beams were called 'electron beams', and Dirty Fighting's shield was never mentioned.
audit.why: Heimerdinger's E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (11s flat, 970 range), stunning a direct hit. His W Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 — 475 further than Avengerang — so rockets, not turret placements, answer his poke. Dirty Fighting shields Akshan on every third hit from attacks and abilities, which eats the front of your burst.
audit.corrected: Answer Avengerang with 1325-range rockets; bleed Dirty Fighting's third-hit shield before committing CH-2, and only stun him once he is inside the turret field.

edits.before: Three turrets make your half of lane a no-entry zone. Only take the trade when Akshan's Heroic Swing is down.
edits.after: Avengerang out-ranges your turrets at 850 and Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1 — he chips you before your nest exists.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Akshan must walk into your range.
edits.after: He pokes with Q from 850 and swings back out before the nest punishes — bank charges and farm behind the beams.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Heroic Swing's cooldown.
edits.after: His first item plus Going Rogue camouflage reclaims map tempo your immobile nest can never rotate to chase.

edits.before: His grapple-swing plus Avengerang Q let him chip you from outside turret range before your second turret charge and CH-3X grenade exist.
edits.after: His grapple-swing plus Avengerang Q let him chip you from outside turret range before your second turret charge and CH-2 grenade exist.

edits.before: He keeps poking with Q from range and swings back out before your nest can punish, owning the Level 3 farm window.
edits.after: He pokes Avengerang from 850 and swings out before the nest punishes — answer with 1325-range rockets, not turrets.

edits.after: Three turret charges plus the CH-2 grenade stun make a grapple-swing into the nest suicidal, but Dirty Fighting shields every third hit.

edits.after: Akshan's window: his Avengerang Q and grapple-swing range let him chip you off CS from outside turret range before your second Q charge and your CH-2 grenade come online.

edits.after: Three turret charges plus the CH-2 grenade stun — if he swings in to trade, the turret beams plus the stun lock him in your zone and delete him.

edits.after: Set up a three-turret nest on the wave so his grapple-swing entry walks into the turret beams plus your CH-2 stun

edits.before: Akshan's whole game early is staying out of the nest — his Avengerang Q pokes you from range and his grapple-swing keeps him outside your CH-3X grenade radius, and you're the squishy yordle taking the worse end of it at Levels 2-3 before your second turret charge and your stun exist. Don't chase a Q with a turret-place; bank charges and farm safely behind the beams. Your one real threat is the CH-3X center-stun, so bait a swing-in and only commit the grenade when he is actually inside the turret field, not skirting the edge of it.
edits.after: Akshan's whole game early is staying out of the nest — his Avengerang Q pokes you from 850 and his grapple-swing keeps him outside your CH-2 grenade radius, and you're the squishy yordle taking the worse end of it at Levels 2-3 before your second turret charge and your stun exist. Don't chase a Q with a turret-place; bank charges and farm safely behind the beams. Your one real threat is the CH-2 direct-hit stun, so bait a swing-in and only commit the grenade when he is actually inside the turret field, not skirting it.

edits.before: This is where you flip it. By Levels 4-5 you have three turret charges plus the center-stun grenade, so the lane becomes a fortified zone — if Akshan grapple-swings in to skirmish, the electron beams plus a CH-3X stun mean he cannot out-DPS three turrets while locked in CC. At 6, bank UPGRADE for the wider, longer-stunning grenade and punish the swing-in, or drop a super-turret to anchor the zone. The catch: he never has to enter, so zone him off CS and deny farm rather than expecting a clean kill on a slippery, dash-heavy target.
edits.after: This is where you flip it. By Levels 4-5 you have three turret charges plus the CH-2 stun grenade, so the lane becomes a fortified zone — if Akshan grapple-swings in to skirmish, the turret beams plus a direct-hit stun mean he cannot out-DPS three turrets while locked in CC, and Dirty Fighting only shields every third hit. At 6, bank UPGRADE!!! for the wider, longer stun and punish the swing-in, or drop a super-turret to anchor the zone. The catch: he never has to enter, so zone him off CS rather than expecting a clean kill.

edits.before: Track Akshan's Heroic Swing: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Turret nest + E stun.
edits.after: Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1 and needs terrain to grapple — CH-2 stun him only once he is inside the turret field.

notes: Ratings on the three flipped rows moved with them. The mirror audit raises an unresolved question: Comeuppance stops on the first champion, minion or STRUCTURE hit — if Heimerdinger's deployed turrets count as structures, a turret between them would eat the whole ultimate. Riot's data does not classify turret units, so nothing on the page asserts it either way.
